title: Extension by zero adjunction preserving monomorphisms
statement: For a category C, a Grothendieck topology J on C, and W : C, assuming HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat and HasSheafify (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat, there exists a functor L : Sheaf (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat ⥤ Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat with Nonempty (L ⊣ J.overPullback AddCommGrpCat W) and L.PreservesMonomorphisms.

proof.text: Construct extension by zero on presheaves by direct sums over arrows into W, sheafify, and use the sheafification adjunction to obtain the left adjunction. Sectionwise injectivity of direct sums and exactness of abelian-group sheafification show preservation of monomorphisms.
